title: VTC Events — List — payload
description: List the events the caller may see. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

from.description: Only events still running at or after this instant.

to.description: Only events starting before this instant.

mine.description: Only events the caller is going to, said maybe to, awaits a decision on, or is waitlisted for.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Events — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/list/0.1#response.

items.description: The events the caller may see, earliest start first.

myStatus.description: The caller's own registration status, where they have a registration.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items follow: pass it as `cursor` to continue.
